portfolio.name: Sebetralstat
portfolio.positioning: First oral on-demand treatment for HAE attacks. Enables at-home treatment without injection, targeting faster time-to-treatment and improved adherence versus injectable on-demand options.
keyEndpoints: Time to beginning of symptom relief
Time to complete resolution of attack

portfolio.name: KVD824 (illustrative label)
portfolio.positioning: Follow-on oral asset positioned for prophylaxis, intended to complement sebetralstat and build a dual oral franchise (on-demand + prophylaxis) over the medium term.

strategicPriorities: Establish oral on-demand as new standard of care for HAE attacks
Execute commercial launch in US and key EU markets
Differentiate versus injectable on-demand (Firazyr, icatibant generics) and versus oral prophylaxis (Orladeyo)
Defend first-mover position ahead of Pharvaris deucrictibant entry
Build evidence base for patient-reported outcomes and real-world use
keyIntelligenceQuestions: Who is closest to an oral on-demand competitor, and what is their timeline?
How are prophylaxis incumbents defending share against oral entrants?
What real-world evidence narratives are competitors building?
Where are competitors investing commercially (geography, field force, patient services)?
What pricing and access precedents are being set for oral HAE therapies?
